title: UI风格#79 - Parisian Boutique (巴黎精品店)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Parisian Boutique style When color palette Then features blush pink, cream, black, gold accents

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Parisian Boutique style When layout Then elegant displays, soft lighting, luxury spacing
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: cream/linen/parchment textures, blush-pink/gold/champagne gradients, elegant soft aesthetic

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Parisian Boutique style When UI elements Then velvet textures, gold accents, soft shadows
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: blush-pink/gold borders, gold top gradient cards, black button with gold border, soft shadow effects, gentle hover transitions

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Parisian Boutique UI When functional Then includes boutique chat, designer agents, collection stats
